16:35.text: And those who associate others with Allāh say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except

16:36.text: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger,
And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was
through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

16:37.text: if you should strive for their guidance,
, indeed, Allāh does not guide those He sends astray,
and they will have no helpers.

16:38.text: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths
Allāh will not resurrect one who dies. But yes -
upon Him, but most of the people do not know.

16:39.text: so He will make clear to them
that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

16:40.text: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.

16:41.text: Allāh after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.

16:42.text: those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
